paper_metadata.title: A 20-dB Gain W-band InP DHBT Power Amplifier
paper_metadata.abstract: A two-stage double heterojunction bipolar transistor molecular beam epitaxy (GSMBE) on semi-insulating InP (DHBT) power MMIC fabricated in InP technology is realized substrate [3]. A single finger DHBT device with an emitter using coplanar waveguide structure. The output cell unit consists size of 1.0 m × 15 m has Tf of 167 GHz , of 284GHz, f of four parallel cascode fingers. Sixteen fingers are at output max stage from which the power is combined. Broad-band, low-loss and breakdown voltage BVceo above 6V. matching networks lead to high gain and high combining efficiency. The chip area is 1.5h1.7 mm2. Measurements show that small signal gain is above 20 dB over 75.5 GHz ̚ 84.5 GHz n+-In0.53Ga0.47As 100 nm frequency band.
